title: Grateful Dead Live at Iowa State Fairgrounds on 1973-05-13
lineage: CD -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.21 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Stunning soundboard remaster with a blazing Other One → Eyes of the World → China Doll sequence.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear, well‑balanced sound—thanks to an excellent remaster and clean instrument separation. Musically the show shines on The Other One, Eyes of the World and a superb China Doll, with a space‑jam vibe that makes this set a standout. Overall both performance and recording are judged as top‑notch.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are 4–5 stars, praising both the superb remastered soundboard quality and the outstanding performances of key songs.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remaster praised as excellent; reviewers note crystal‑clear vocals, clean instrument separation and overall terrific audio fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions highlighted especially the jam from The Other One into Eyes of the World, creating a space‑jam atmosphere that drives the set.
